subject: Re: Ops architecture deep-dive — final agenda & slot update
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@acme.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Gustavo Fernández <gustavo.fernandez@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: ops architecture deep-dive (Redwood)

Hi Hannah,

Hope you’re well — ACME infra team would like to do a technical deep-dive with Redwood to validate the proposed deployment pattern and run-of-show for our pilot. We’re aiming for a 60–90 minute session that covers: runtime topology, network flows (VPC peering + NAT), data residency, and fallback/HA behavior.

Proposed windows next week: Wednesday 12/2 10:00–11:30 PT or Thursday 12/3 14:00–15:30 PT. Primary attendees from our side will be myself, Gustavo Fernández (infra), and Elaine Park (security consultant). Can you confirm availability and share an initial agenda and any pre-reads/slides you want us to review?

Thanks — we’d like the session recorded and any artifacts (slides/diagrams) ahead of time.
Best,
Samir Khan
ACME Corp — Staff Technical Program Manager

[attachment: none]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@acme.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: ops architecture deep-dive (Redwood)

Hi Samir — thanks for reaching out. Both slots look doable on our end; tentative preference for Thursday 12/3 14:00–15:30 PT to give our infra and product leads time to prep.

Proposed session outline (high level):
- 5m: introductions & goals
- 15m: Redwood runtime topology & model routing
- 25m: Network / VPC patterns and firewall considerations
- 10m: Security controls (KMS, audit logs) — Laura to cover
- 20m: Failure modes & fallbacks, scaling behavior, load tests
- 15m: Q&A + next steps

Attachments I’ll circulate: a short slide deck (v0.1) and a one-page pre-read with links to our readiness checklist. Jonas — can you attach the current network diagram you have for the Dedicated deployment?
If Thursday works, I’ll send a calendar invite and a Zoom link. Also: do you need any special NDAs or evidence ahead of time (SOC2 artifacts)?
Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Lead Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[hannah mobile: +1-415-555-0139]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: ops architecture deep-dive (Redwood)

Hi all — adding the network diagram and a quick note on IP/port expectations.

Attachment: network_diag_20261202.png (stub) — shows recommended subnetting for Dedicated pools and the NAT path for KV-cache retrieval. Two quick calls-outs:
- If ACME plans to put Redwood in a private subnet with no outbound internet, we’ll need an egress proxy for model cache misses (describe in the diagram).
- For load tests, plan for sticky routing to the same GPU pool for warm KV-cache fidelity.
Also: Laura — can you confirm who will cover KMS and audit logs in the security section? We should include a one-slide matrix of required artifacts for procurement if Samir wants them pre-shared.
-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: network_diag_20261202.png]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@acme.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Final agenda + pre-reads for Thurs 12/3 ops deep-dive (14:00 PT)

Samir — thanks, Thursday 12/3 14:00–15:30 PT is confirmed (invite sent). Threading final agenda and pre-reads below. Please review the 3 short items before the call: the slide deck, the network diagram (Jonas attached), and the pre-read doc with our recommended config and a procurement artifact checklist.

Final agenda (90m):
- 14:00–14:05: Welcome & objectives (Hannah)
- 14:05–14:20: Redwood runtime & model routing overview (Marissa)
- 14:20–14:40: Network topology, peering, and NAT considerations (Jonas)
- 14:40–14:50: Security controls: KMS, audit logs, data residency (Laura)
- 14:50–15:10: Failure/fallback modes and autoscaling behavior (Hannah + Marissa)
- 15:10–15:25: Open technical Q&A (All)
- 15:25–15:30: Next steps & recording/navigation (Samir + Hannah)
Pre-reads (short):
- redwood_ops_arch_v3.pdf — 8-slide deck, quick topology + run-of-show (attached)
- pre-read-ops.md — configuration checklist & procurement artifacts (attached)
- network_diag_20261202.png — logical diagram (attached)
Links: Zoom meeting (in invite), shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExampleDriveLink/ACME-Redwood-PreReads, Confluence page: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/ACME+Ops+Deep+Dive
Notes / asks for ACME:
- Please confirm the list of attendees that will join for the technical Q&A (especially anyone from your NAT/firewall team).
- If you want SOC2 artifacts in advance, let us know and we’ll share the relevant evidence bundle under an NDA link.

Attachments: redwood_ops_arch_v3.pdf, pre-read-ops.md, network_diag_20261202.png
Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.

Laura Bennett
Product Security Lead, Redwood Inference
Office: +1-650-555-0199
[attachment: redwood_ops_arch_v3.pdf, pre-read-ops.md]

From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@acme.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Gustavo Fernández <gustavo.fernandez@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Final agenda + pre-reads for Thurs 12/3 ops deep-dive (14:00 PT)

Thanks — confirm we got the invite and pre-reads. Quick ask before the call: would you be able to move the session 30 minutes later (to 14:30 PT) because Gustavo has an overlapping procurement review that just changed. If that’s tight for the Redwood team we can keep 14:00 and Gustavo will join the tail end.

Also: brief note — please include one slide on authentication modes (API key vs mTLS) and whether Redwood has short-lived credentials or recommended rotation cadence. I saw a brief mention in the pre-read but could not find the detailed policy.
If you can push to 14:30, please update the calendar; otherwise we’ll proceed at 14:00 and join when possible.
Best,
Samir
ACME Corp — Staff TPM
